itens.trecho: Realmente um bom filme, que justifica o falatório em torno dele. Quem não se lembra de “La La Land”? Foi em 2016 que saiu para os teatros, e foi um dos mais vistos e aclamados filmes desse ano.
Really a good movie, which justifies the hype around it. Who doesn't remember “La La Land”? It was released in theaters in 2016, and was one of the most viewed and acclaimed films of that year.

"To me, La La Land is like religion. I see the appeal, and I would never take it away from anyone. But I would also never stand in line for it." - Jeff WInger, probably. Final rating:★★½ - Not quite for me, but I definitely get the appeal.
